review_notes: Schema 2 manifest, verifier and final release verification report are preserved byte-for-byte in baseline/modernization-v2; prior review notes remain there.
User explicitly requested WASD movement, left mouse confirm, right mouse back/run, a full animated Pokemon summary and exclusive modern rendering during field actions.

InputProcessor moves from immutable originals to a narrowly reviewed change list. Attack, Battle, Player, PkmnMap, Network, Save, CheckMovesLearned, CheckEndOfBattle and DrawSetupMenu remain protected against the classic hashes.
Native desktop input/summary checks use simulated polling and real GL rendering; physical gamepad hardware is not exercised.

Coordinated source freeze: parent reviewed Game, WorldBatch and field renderer; sprite agent reviewed complete PMD bounds, event/battle actors and panorama; desktop agent reviewed input aggregation, settings migration and summary presentation.
Game retains original action.firstStep/step dispatch; WorldBatch suppresses only world draw submissions and reads the existing placement-validator tint.

Input transitions use private physical history so consumed public flags cannot duplicate a held mouse click; printable keys remain available to the original nickname/setup text paths. The complete untouched legacy preset migrates, customized presets remain unchanged.
DrawControls uses only bitmap-font-safe separators and a missing-glyph guard even when the legacy draw is suppressed by modern presentation.
All production sources were frozen before setting these hashes; verifier and --inventory cannot refresh approvals. Subsequent source changes must fail this manifest.

Final coordinated freeze includes Regigigas, Mewtwo and Mega Gengar draw paths: original action timing, rock RNG, ripple progression, send-out scheduling and combat formulas are preserved. The legacy 7x7 send-out crop is bounded to its destination array.

The shipped Mega Gengar constructor referenced a species with no ASM. Its dedicated mgengar alias now initializes from a fresh Gengar definition with the same explicit boss stats and moves, without mutating ordinary Gengar. Native tests cover direct fresh-process deserialization, cache clearing and round-trip with cry dex 094; Network and Save remain untouched.
